confidence_notes: Restaurant and drink anchors rest on loosely dated web sources: Expatistan crowd-sourced averages, a tourism-board range, Radical Storage guide figures, and a French price-estimate site for cappuccino. None were checked against current Riga menus. Cocktail is weakly sourced, resting on a single Expatistan downtown-club figure. Wine is based on an undated official tourism range rather than the beer relationship. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates for July peak season and are not based on any inspected booking pages or live listings. Source prices quoted in EUR were converted to USD at an approximate rate. The FX observation comes from a search snapshot of the RBA exchange-rates page and was not independently fetched, so the 2026-10-16 value should be confirmed against the published table.
comparable_city_reasoning: Riga-specific sources were used where available. Expatistan places Riga roughly 8 percent above Sofia and roughly 12 percent below Split, which served as a cross-check for the restaurant and drink tiers. Accommodation tiers reflect general Baltic and Central European capital pricing in summer peak season.
